title: Lot's angelic visitors extract him before Sodom's destruction

tellings.quote: his nephew Lot encounters angelic beings who come to extract him and his family before the destruction of Sodom.
Two angels walk into Sodom the night before the fire falls.
tellings.difference: Gives the number of angels as two and the timing as the night before the fire, but does not mention them taking Lot and his family out.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the angels coming into Sodom on the eve of its destruction, which is the Lot story from Genesis.

as_told.title: Two angels enter Sodom before its destruction

plain: In the Bible's book of Genesis, angelic beings come to Sodom to get Abraham's nephew Lot and his family out before the city is destroyed. The story is told on the podcast as a possible ancient record of non-human visitors. The researcher Tim Alberino retells it from Genesis, saying Lot "encounters angelic beings who come to extract him and his family before the destruction of Sodom." Michels brings up the same scene in an episode about Air Force veterans who say they were abducted. He sets it as "Two angels walk into Sodom the night before the fire falls." His version gives the number of angels and the timing but does not mention the rescue. Both draw on the Bible itself rather than on any other source.
